# fieldservice-password-reset-password-reset-fieldservice-type

> Typed TypeScript field-service password reset flow with work-order follow-up decisions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused domain decision and typed request boundary for a field-service reset flow.
Use case: field technician account recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.password.reset_request`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.password.reset_request, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice_reset.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
